clock_policy: TT_BIO_AICLK=1350, sampled DURING every timed arm; a number without its clock is not a measurement

inherited_measurements.source: c12-kblock-unlock sweep_512_qb2c1.json, qb2 card 1, 1350 MHz, interleaved rep by rep

the_one_unknown: cost of a standalone in-place ttnn.silu on [1,16,512,512] bf16, L1-resident, on Blackhole. Never measured on this arch.

central.basis: census multiply_|out=1x16x512x512 in-place eltwise on exactly this shape, 5.8606e-5 s/call, 429.4 GB/s. Conservative in the right direction: census replayed with DRAM operands, this silu is L1-resident; silu is SFPU-bound not byte-bound.

kill_criteria.a_op_level: silu_ms >= 0.0887 -- the standalone pass costs as much as the epilogue it removes. Lever dead at the op level, stop without spending a fold.
kill_criteria.b_fold_level: fold A/B lands inside 1.000 +/- the campaign 0.055 s A/A floor at 512 aa across two sessions. Central prediction is 4.9x that floor, so the fold is an admissible instrument.

known_answer_controls.bytes_two_ways: a 2097152 + w 131072 + out 8388608 = 10616832 must equal tile-grid count
known_answer_controls.fused_fc1_reproduces_sweep: my fused fc1 arm must read ~0.1201 ms/call, else my program config is not the production one
known_answer_controls.plain_fc2_reproduces_sweep: my plain arm must read ~0.0314 ms/call

sizes: 512 aa decides the lever; 298 aa and 768 aa decide the default (one-size tuning is a standing defect class)
accuracy_stance: not re-spent. b2z2-unfused-silu-recover VERDICT GO, per-pseudo-domain 0.3358 A / 0.3576 A vs the 0.60 A bar, 1.84 A seed floor. b2z2-silu-bh-land re-read it on BH at four seeds: worst 0.4183 A, no clause fired. One paired BH read here to confirm transfer.
